measurement: 1 Hz sampled resources in measured-operation windows only; warmup/setup excluded; descriptive sampling, not continuous tracing
utc_window_mapping: Record started_utc + (completed_perf-started_perf) on Jetson client; 1Hz monitor host UTC; NTP synchronized but subsecond attribution approximate
interpretation_limits: Temperatures and utilization do not establish throttling. No throttle-reason counters were sampled.
GR3D clock MHz is unavailable when tegrastats reports utilization only.
Jetson RAM is unified system memory, not isolated model GPU memory.
Cloud utilization/memory include existing processes; compute-app snapshots were sampled every 10s.
Power rails are as reported by tegrastats; do not sum overlapping rails or equate with wall power.
GPU temperature is absent when the gpu@ temperature token is not present; tj@ is a separate reported sensor.

jetson_configuration_before.note: Preflight configuration only; no per-sample NVPModel polling

monitoring_unavailable_fields: GR3D clock MHz absent: GR3D_FREQ provided percentage only
GPU temperature gpu@ absent from all retained Jetson monitor lines
